units.source_text: 内藏助听十内说这件事，心里五味杂陈，像受到了侮辱一般。

en.t: When Kuranosuke heard Junai speak of this, his feelings were tangled and bitter, as though he had been insulted.

units.source_text: 此外，又情不自禁的回忆以前的放浪行为。

en.t: Besides that, he could not help recalling his former dissipated behavior.

units.source_text: 那些对他来说色彩绚烂的回忆。

en.t: Those memories were vividly colored for him.

units.source_text: 长蜡烛的光、沉香油的香气、三弦奏加贺小调的声音，始终回荡在他的脑海里。

en.t: The light of long candles, the fragrance of aloeswood oil, and the sound of the shamisen playing Kaga ditties kept echoing in his mind.

units.source_text: “果然是，珠泪扑簌，把红袖湿遍，泪扑簌，皮肉生涯，露水缘”，

en.t: Indeed, pearl-like tears fall pattering down, soaking the red sleeves; tears fall, a life of flesh, a bond as fleeting as dew,

units.source_text: 十内说起的《花街小景》的歌词中的场景，

en.t: the scenes from the lyrics of Scenes of the Pleasure Quarter that Junai had mentioned,

units.source_text: 和魅力妖娆的如同出自东宫的夕雾和浮桥，也飘荡在他脑海里。

en.t: and the bewitching Yugiri and Ukihashi, as alluring as if they had stepped out of the Eastern Palace, also drifted through his mind.

units.source_text: 他曾经如此尽情的享受过放浪形骸的生活啊。

en.t: He had once enjoyed a life of reckless pleasure so completely.

units.source_text: 在那段不羁的生活里，很多次他感到快乐似神仙，将复仇抛之脑后。

en.t: In that unrestrained life, he had many times felt as happy as an immortal and had put revenge out of his mind.

units.source_text: 他是个正直而理智的人，不想自欺欺人的否定那些事实。

en.t: He was an honest and rational man, and he did not want to deny those facts by deceiving himself.

units.source_text: 当然，深谙人性的他，做梦也不认为这件事是违背道德的。

en.t: Of course, being deeply versed in human nature, he never dreamed that this was immoral.

units.source_text: 就因为这样，对他的放浪形骸都看做尽忠的一种手段，既让他感到不快又让他觉得愧疚。

en.t: Precisely for that reason, having his dissipation treated as a means of loyal service both displeased him and made him feel guilty.
